explanation: h(n) (cofactorThreshold) is the largest m such that every n-element A ⊆ ℕ has at least m distinct values a/(a,b), as on erdosproblems.com/539. Allowing 0 ∈ A changes counts by O(1) at most, which is irrelevant here. Erdős–Szemerédi proved n^{1/2} ≪ h(n). The statement √n = O(h(n)) matches. Faithful.
